# TBP18S030 - 256-bit (32 x 8) Schottky TTL programmable read-only memory, three-state outputs

Package DIP-16 · family bipolar-PROM · catalogue file [catalog/chips/TBP18S030.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/TBP18S030.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Q0 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 0; three-state |
| 2 | Q1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 1; three-state |
| 3 | Q2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 2; three-state |
| 4 | Q3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 3; three-state |
| 5 | Q4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 4; three-state |
| 6 | Q5 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 5; three-state |
| 7 | Q6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 6; three-state |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | Q7 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G; output bit 7; three-state |
| 10 | A0 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | /G | enable | low |  | controls pins 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9; when not enabled: float; chip select (drawn G with a bar; logic symbol EN): low enables the outputs, high turns them off |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V; +5 V +-5% |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 1-7,9 | Q0-Q7 give the 8-bit word addressed by A4..A0 while G is low; high impedance while G is high. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 256


## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -6.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Commercial (J, N): VCC 4.75..5.25 V, IOH -6.5 mA, IOL 20 mA; VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V; VOH 2.4 V min (3.2 typ), VOL 0.5 V max; IOZH 50 uA, IOZL -50 uA; IIH 25 uA, IIL -250 uA (p-n-p inputs); IOS -30..-100 mA; ICC 80 typ, 110 max mA. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A0 | Q0 | access | 25 | 40 | CL 30 pF |
| G | Q0 | access | 12 | 25 | access time from chip select (enable time), CL 30 pF |
| G | Q0 | PXZ | 8 | 20 | disable time from high or low level, CL 5 pF |

## Not known

- The bit pattern stored in this card's PROMs: card specific and not read.

## Notes

Card 3207 positions 3H, 4H, 10F, 11F (G tied to GND on the card). The memory of the behaviour has no defined contents.

## Sources

- [TI The Bipolar Microcomputer Components Data Book, 3rd edition 1981: Series 14 and 18 Programmable Read-Only Memories (June 1981)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1981_TI_The_Bipolar_Microcomputer_Components_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_3ed.pdf) - pdf 31-36 (printed 2-7..2-11); TBP18S030 (J, N), old type number SN74S288
